nodes.label: Stakeholder Information Sharing
nodes.rationale: Each stakeholder (manufacturer, distributor, wholesaler) needs different information from others to run the supply chain smoothly, but stakeholders are unwilling to share all of their information with others, which is the central challenge current traceability solutions must address.

nodes.label: Supply Chain Decision Automation
nodes.rationale: Business planners spend significant time understanding optimization tool outputs, running what-if analyses, and updating mathematical models, requiring data-science teams and slowing decisions; applying LLMs to these three tasks removes the human-in-the-loop bottleneck, cutting decision time from days/weeks to minutes/hours.

nodes.label: Dual-Layer Optimization Framework
nodes.rationale: A dual-layer optimization is used to reduce variability and exceedance probabilities in finished goods arising from stochastic wafer batch transfers, trading additional modeling complexity for measurable gains in cost efficiency, productivity, and resource utilization.

nodes.label: Material Consolidation Trade-off
nodes.rationale: Consolidating multi-to-multi material relationships across supply-chain tiers shifts costs between tiers (lower cost in one, higher in the other); a holistic reconfiguration across both tiers reduces overall procurement cost even though it increases cost locally in one tier, with reductions growing as second-tier fixed ordering costs and machining options increase.

nodes.label: VSG-based BESS Sizing Model for Virtual Inertia Emulation
nodes.norm_label: vsg-based bess sizing model for virtual inertia emulation
nodes.rationale: Renewable generation displacing synchronous generators lowers system inertia and threatens frequency stability; existing VSG-based DERs mimic SG inertia/droop/damping but don't optimally solve frequency stability, so this empirical model sizes the BESS needed for inertia emulation and damping given droop gain Kω, droop coefficient Kd, and VSG time constant Ta, validated via EMTP simulation of a PV-based VSG on a 9-bus grid under a symmetric fault.

nodes.label: Dynamic Reconstruction (mechanism analysis for distributed PEES)
nodes.norm_label: dynamic reconstruction (mechanism analysis for distributed pees)
nodes.rationale: Proposed because traditional stability mechanism analysis methods, though effective for single grid-connected PEES and large-scale parallel/series-connected PEES, are inadequate for PEES with distributed connections; simplified PEES models can also cause 'error aggregation' as PEES scale increases.

nodes.label: Lyapunov Optimization for Storage-Cooperation Tradeoff
nodes.rationale: Formulates the choice between storage (smooths fluctuations across time) and cooperative energy exchange among distributed sources (averages variation across space) as a stochastic time-average cost-minimization problem, solved via Lyapunov optimization; finds cooperation matters most when storage is limited and most of its benefit comes from exchanging among just a few sources, informing investment tradeoffs.

nodes.label: Distributed Real-Time Power Balancing Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Decentralizes a centralized real-time power-balancing solution (which accounts for renewable, load, and price uncertainty) into a distributed implementation to significantly cut computational burden and communication overhead, letting each renewable generator and the aggregator decide independently while staying asymptotically optimal as storage capacity grows.

nodes.label: Cooperation and Storage Tradeoffs in Power-Grids with Renewable Energy Resources
nodes.norm_label: cooperation and storage tradeoffs in power-grids with renewable energy resources

nodes.label: Distributed Real-Time Power Balancing in Renewable-Integrated Power Grids with Storage and Flexible Loads
nodes.norm_label: distributed real-time power balancing in renewable-integrated power grids with storage and flexible loads

nodes.label: Privacy-Preserving Distributed SoC Balancing Control
nodes.rationale: Distributed control offers scalability/resilience for coordinating networked BESSs but requires inter-agent information exchange that raises privacy concerns; a state-decomposition-based average-state estimator lets agents jointly balance state-of-charge and deliver desired global power without disclosing sensitive internal states to peers or external eavesdroppers.

nodes.label: Shared Energy Storage Management Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Installing large numbers of individual ESSs per consumer is impractical (space, cost); instead jointly optimizes charge/discharge of one shared ESS across multiple users given a profit-coefficient set specifying each user's allocated share, shown on California data to raise total profit ~10% over individual-ESS ownership.

nodes.label: South Pole Hybrid Renewable Energy System (PV + wind + Li-ion storage)
nodes.norm_label: south pole hybrid renewable energy system (pv + wind + li-ion storage)
nodes.rationale: Least-cost configuration for a 170kW steady-state load combines 180kW-DC PV, 570kW wind, and a 3.4MWh Li-ion BESS alongside existing diesel; reduces diesel consumption 95%, avoids ~1200 metric tons CO2/year, and nets $57M savings over 15 years with ~2-year payback, motivating a shift from all-diesel generation at this extremely remote, high-power-need site.

nodes.label: BI-temporal Iterative Interaction (BI3) Layer
nodes.rationale: Proposed to enhance the MCI model's discriminative feature representation capability across the pixel-level detection and semantic-level captioning branches.

nodes.label: Change-Agent (interactive RS change interpretation system)
nodes.rationale: Existing change-detection/change-captioning methods each provide only limited, single-task interpretation; Change-Agent integrates the MCI model as the 'eyes' and an LLM as the 'brain' so users can interactively obtain comprehensive interpretation (detection, captioning, object counting, cause analysis) via natural-language instructions.

nodes.label: LEVIR-MCI Dataset
nodes.rationale: Built with a large number of change masks and captions specifically to support training of the MCI model's dual detection/captioning branches.

nodes.label: RS-STVLM (Remote Sensing SpatioTemporal Vision-Language Models)
nodes.rationale: Motivated because prior change-detection methods only produce binary/semantic masks that fall short of human-readable insight; fusing vision and language enables descriptive captions and natural-language query answering over spatio-temporal changes.

nodes.label: Agricultural Data Warehouse for Precision Agriculture
nodes.norm_label: agricultural data warehouse for precision agriculture
nodes.rationale: Designed to handle agricultural Big Data (spatial, temporal, complex, heterogeneous, non-standardized; high volume/variety/velocity/veracity) with privacy, security and real-time access across stakeholders (farmers, equipment makers, agribusinesses, co-ops, government), as the key foundation for a crop intelligence platform enabling resource-efficient agronomy decisions, since few prior works addressed efficient warehouse design for this data.

nodes.label: Crop Yield Estimation Deep Learning Model
nodes.norm_label: crop yield estimation deep learning model
nodes.rationale: Uses crop calendars, easy-to-obtain remote sensing data, and weather forecasts for pre-season and in-season prediction across five crops, avoiding heavy reliance on NDVI which is degraded by cloud/shadow occlusion and lack of reliable crop masks in developing countries.

nodes.label: HDI-PRNet (High-order Degradation Imaging Progressive Restoration Network)
nodes.norm_label: hdi-prnet (high-order degradation imaging progressive restoration network)
nodes.rationale: Built on the theoretical framework of degradation imaging (Markov properties of high-order degradation, MAP estimation) to give a mathematically interpretable unfolding-network architecture, addressing the criticism that deep-learning RS restoration methods lack architecture transparency and model interpretability; composed of denoising (proximal mapping prior learning), deblurring (Neumann series expansion + dual-domain degradation learning), and super-resolution modules.

nodes.label: Query Expansion Method (no external inputs)
nodes.rationale: Increases overall retrieval performance by about 3% using only the top-three retrieved images, without requiring any external inputs.

nodes.label: VLAD (Vector of Locally Aggregated Descriptors)
nodes.rationale: Aggregates attentive local convolutional features into a global descriptor to handle the semantic diversity of remote sensing imagery; even untrained, outperforms other systems, and after tuning is state-of-the-art or competitive.

nodes.label: TimeSenCLIP
nodes.rationale: Unlike prior VLMs adapted from generic very-high-resolution architectures that prioritize spatial context and depend on caption-based supervision, TimeSenCLIP uses a cross-view temporal contrastive framework aligning multispectral Sentinel-2 time series with geo-tagged ground imagery without textual annotations, emphasizing temporal/spectral signal so it works on medium-resolution imagery down to single-pixel time series.

nodes.rationale: A single RCM (e.g. PRECIS) carries large uncertainty at regional scale; using an ensemble of multi-RCM projections driven by multiple global coupled models under different RCP scenarios is needed to capture the probable path of future climate and its impacts.

nodes.rationale: RTMs are computationally expensive and limit use with high-volume imaging spectrometers; emulating them with a neural network trades a small approximation error for a multifold speedup, enabling large-scale downstream remote-sensing analysis.
